metric_justification: F1-Score was selected as the primary quality gate metric because Resume Inflation Detection is an imbalanced classification problem where both False Positives and False Negatives have high business costs. A False Positive wrongly penalizes an honest applicant, damaging candidate experience; whereas a False Negative allows an unqualified applicant to slip into technical rounds, wasting engineering interview bandwidth. F1-Score takes the harmonic mean of Precision and Recall, preventing the accuracy paradox.
reason: Candidate model achieved F1-Score of 0.9200 (>= 0.82) and outperformed/tied the existing champion (0.4216). Promoted to production.
